name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages

# 推送到 main 分支即自动部署
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:   # 也可在 GitHub 网页手动触发

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Build & Deploy

    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
      - name: 检出代码
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 安装 Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      # 这一步就是「那一条命令」——在 GitHub 的服务器上执行，不用你本机装任何东西
      - name: 部署到 Cloudflare Pages
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: pages deploy public --project-name=cf-weather --branch=main
